plans.name: Moderato
plans.note: All Kimi membership features share a single credit pool metered by token usage. Agent credit values are approximate based on typical task token consumption; monthly credits are converted to the equivalent number of tasks for the same feature and are for reference only. Kimi Code has a separate 5-hour / weekly rate limit, but the page does not state its numeric amount.
